audit: FASE 2 - Enumeração completa do backend Supabase (censo de objetos e estado)

rows.version: PostgreSQL 15.8 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (GCC) 13.2.0, 64-bit

24_extensions.sql: SELECT extname, extversion FROM pg_extension ORDER BY 1

25_roles.sql: SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles ORDER BY 1

25_role_settings.sql: SELECT r.rolname, s.setconfig FROM pg_db_role_setting s JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.setrole ORDER BY 1

setconfig: search_path="$user", public, evo, zapp, bpm, email_app, monitoring, extensions
search_path="$user", public, evo, zapp, bpm, email_app, monitoring, extensions

26_namespaces.sql: SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace ORDER BY 1

26_namespace_classification.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE nspname LIKE 'pg\_temp\_%') AS temp_schemas, count(*) FILTER (WHERE nspname LIKE 'pg\_toast\_temp\_%') AS toast_temp_schemas, count(*) FILTER (WHERE nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\_temp\_%' AND nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\_toast\_temp\_%') AS regular_schemas FROM pg_namespace

27_census.sql: SELECT nspname, count(*) FILTER (WHERE relkind='r') AS tables, count(*) FILTER (WHERE relkind='v') AS views, count(*) FILTER (WHERE relkind='m') AS matviews, count(*) FILTER (WHERE relkind='p') AS partitioned FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

27_functions.sql: SELECT n.nspname, count(*) AS functions FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

28_cron_jobs.sql: SELECT jobid, jobname, schedule, active FROM cron.job ORDER BY 1

29_realtime_publication.sql: SELECT schemaname, tablename FROM pg_publication_tables WHERE pubname='supabase_realtime' ORDER BY 1,2

30_replication_slots.sql: SELECT slot_name, active, wal_status FROM pg_replication_slots

31_storage_buckets.sql: SELECT id, name, public FROM storage.buckets ORDER BY 1

32_auth_users.sql: SELECT count(*) AS users FROM auth.users

32_auth_identities.sql: SELECT provider, count(*) FROM auth.identities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

32_profiles.sql: SELECT count(*) AS profiles FROM zapp.profiles

33_migrations.sql: SELECT version, name FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations ORDER BY 1

34_gucs.sql: SELECT name, setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name LIKE 'app.%' OR name LIKE 'pgrst.%'

35_vault_secrets.sql: SELECT count(*) AS secrets FROM vault.secrets
